artworks.title: William Cecil, Lord Burleigh
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man within an oval frame. The man has a full beard and mustache, wearing a cap with a emblem and a detailed garment with a ruffled collar. He also wears a chain with a medallion around his neck and holds a rod in one hand. Below the portrait is a sculptural element with a cherub sitting beside a dog, holding a rod entwined with a snake. The background features architectural elements resembling a stone wall with intricate designs and the inscription "WILLIAM CECIL LORD BURLEIGH" on a plinth.

artworks.title: William Cecil, First Baron Burghley
artworks.description: This image is an engraved portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing forward with his gaze slightly to the side. He has a beard and mustache, and is wearing a hat with a badge. He is dressed in elaborate clothing with a ruffled collar typical of the Elizabethan era. The man holds a baton and wears a chain of office, suggesting authority. The background is decorated with symbols, floral motifs, and Latin inscriptions. An inscription identifies the man as Sir William Cecil.

artworks.title: William Cecil, First Baron Burghley
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper body portrait of a man turned slightly to his right. He has a distinct face with prominent features, such as a high forehead, intense eyes, a sharp nose, a beard, and a mustache. His hair is short and closely cropped. The man is dressed in a richly patterned coat with a large, fur-trimmed collar. He holds a large letter "B" with his left hand and a small book or paper with his right hand. The background features architectural elements with ornate columns and arches, with “CORYNNA” and “RUTANIA” inscribed on the structure.

artworks.title: William Cecil, First Baron Burghley
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image portrays a man from the waist up, facing forward with his head slightly turned to the left. He has a long beard and mustache, with a serious expression on his face. He wears a cap with a brim and an elaborate garment with a high ruff around his neck and a decorative robe. The background features a patterned oval frame with the name "GUILIELMUS" and additional text around it.

artworks.title: William Cecil, First Baron Burghley
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up, in front of an architectural backdrop. The man is standing and facing forward, holding a large book in his left hand while his right hand rests on the top of a sizable ornamental letter "B." He has a long, pointed beard and thinning hair on the top of his head, which is neatly combed back. His outfit is elaborate, featuring a high-collared, fur-trimmed coat over an ornately patterned robe. Behind him, the background consists of a detailed, arch-like architectural setting with columns and ornate carvings.

artworks.title: Willmus Burton de Falde (William Burton)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up. He is positioned with his body angled slightly to the left, while his head is turned towards the viewer. The man has a high forehead with receding hair, short hair around the sides and back of his head, and a trimmed beard. He is wearing a detailed outfit typical of the early 17th century, featuring a high ruff collar, intricate patterns on the fabric of his clothing, and frilled cuffs. He holds a pair of gloves in his right hand, with his left hand rested on a book on a table. The background features an ornate oval design suggesting a frame, with decorative elements such as a dragon and a crest with two lions and a crescent moon with stars. The text within the oval frame identifies the man as William Burton, with the year 1622.

artworks.title: Willmus Burton de Falde (William Burton)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in formal attire from the early 17th century standing upright. He has a receding hairline, short hair, a neatly trimmed beard, and a mustache. The man wears an outfit with a high ruffled collar, a patterned doublet, and large lace cuffs. He holds a roll of parchment in his right hand, resting against his chest. On a desk in front of him, there is an inkwell, quill, and an open book. In the background, there is a detailed engraving with the man's name and the date 1622 inscribed around his circularly framed portrait. The engraving includes heraldic symbols, such as a dragon on a helmet on the left, three lion heads and two animal heads on the right, and a shield with celestial symbols below the oval.

artworks.title: William Butler, Physician
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with one hand resting on a book. He is facing forward with a slight turn to the side. The man's facial features include a long nose, pronounced cheekbones, and a short beard and mustache. He wears an embroidered cap and a robe with a fur collar. The robe has buttons down the front. The man's hand is on a book. The background has an oval frame with inscriptions and a decorative scroll with text.

artworks.title: William Butler, Physician
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up, seated in a slightly turned position with hands resting one over the other. The person has a beard and mustache, and is wearing a cap with a pattern. They are dressed in formal attire with a cloak and wide collar. The portrait is in an oval frame with text along the edges, and there is a plaque below with an inscription. The background is an off-white, aged paper with an ornate border.

artworks.title: Dr. William Butler
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man in an upper-body portrait. His body faces slightly left while he looks at the viewer. He has a long white beard, a mustache, and wears a cap with elaborate designs. The man is wearing a richly decorated coat with fur-like features around the collar. He is seated and rests his hands on a book. The background features an oval frame with ornamental designs. The text around the frame identifies him and hints at a scholarly context.

artworks.title: Sir Julius Caesar
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, with a short beard and mustache, wearing Renaissance clothing and a large hat, holding a scroll. He is in front of an ornate frame with Latin inscriptions, an intricate design, and a coat of arms above his head.

artworks.title: Sir Julius Caesar
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of Sir Julius Caesar, shown from the waist up in a frontal position. He has a serious expression, a full beard, and a mustache. He wears a cap and an elaborate ruff collar with a formal, ornate dark garment. He holds a cylindrical object in his left hand, possibly a scroll. The background includes a textured curtain, shelves with large books, and a coat of arms with text specifying his name and titles.

artworks.title: John Caius, Co-Founder of Gonville and Caius College, Cambridge
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a man's profile, with the left side of his face visible. He has a nose, high forehead, beard, mustache, short hair with a receding hairline, and is wearing a garment with a high collar and a fur cloak or robe. The background is monochrome with a textured pattern. Below the image is a section with Latin text.

artworks.title: John Calvin
artworks.description: This print shows a man standing upright, facing the left, holding an open book with one hand and turning the pages in the other hand. He has pale skin, a long nose, a long, pointed beard, deep-set eyes, and thin lips set in a neutral expression. He is wearing a flat, wide-brimmed cap with flaps on the side and a floor-length robe with fur lining at the collar and cuffs. Behind him, on the right, is a shelf lined with books. Below the shelf is a cushioned chair. On the left is a table with more books, one of them open, a candle, and thin quills in a container by the books and papers. The table is covered with a cloth, and above it is a window with a dark curtain drawn to the left side. Behind the man's head is a round wall ornament, and near the upper right corner of the print is a framed picture or map on the wall. The floor below the man has a checkerboard pattern, and more books are stacked on a platform in the bottom right corner, with small stairs visible in the bottom left corner. Below the print are several lines of text.

artworks.title: John Calvin
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in profile facing left. He is seated at a slight angle, showing his upper body. The man has a pointed nose, long chin, beard, and wears a cap. He is dressed in a dark robe with a fur collar, and a high, stiff collar underneath. He holds an open book in his left hand and gestures with his right hand. The background has vertical lines. The portrait is surrounded by a border, with text above and below identifying the person as "IOHANNES CALVINVS, THEOL. SINCERISS."

artworks.title: William Camden, Herald, Antiquary and Historian
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a beard and mustache, shown from the shoulders up and facing the viewer with a slight turn to the right. He has an angular face with pronounced cheekbones, a wide forehead, small and deep-set eyes, short hair, and is wearing a snug cap. His clothing consists of a high-collared garment, possibly a doublet, under a voluminous ruff collar. The background features an oval frame with detailed line work, and a decorated cartouche with the name "GUILLAUME, CAMDEN." The paper has a texture reminiscent of a historical print style.

artworks.title: William Camden, Herald, Antiquary and Historian
artworks.description: This print shows a man from the waist up, holding a small book in both hands. He has pale skin, a white mustache, a pointed white beard, a long nose, deep-set eyes, and thin lips set in a slight smile. He wears a black cap over the top of his head and a long-sleeved black garment with a high ruffled collar and white cuffs at his wrists. The area around him is filled with dark, crosshatched lines surrounded by an oval frame. Beyond the frame are the shapes of bugs, flowers, vines, and small, foxlike animals. Latin text surrounds the portrait's oval frame and additional text is below in a square border surrounded by scrollwork and small columns.

artworks.title: Vincentius Carafa, Jesuit
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. His head and shoulders are turned slightly to the right. He has a neutral expression, with a high forehead, defined cheekbones, and a thin mustache. His hair is sparse and closely cropped. The man is wearing a dark robe or cloak with a high collar and a white collar underneath. The background is plain and dark, with an oval frame around the subject. There is an inscription in Latin below the portrait.

artworks.title: Peter de Carcavy
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to his left. He has a mature face with prominent cheekbones and deep-set eyes. His hair is curly and shoulder-length. He wears a formal garment with a wide white collar and a dark robe with a subtle pattern. The portrait is in an oval frame with inscriptions around it, possibly in Latin. Below the oval, there is a decorative crest with a shield including a lamb and star symbols, along with other ornamental elements. The background consists of finely engraved lines.

artworks.title: Sir Nicholas Caren of Beddington
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrait of a man standing with his body slightly turned to the side. He has a serious expression and wears a large curly wig. He is clad in a formal, buttoned coat with decorative elements. His left hand is on his hip, and he holds a cane in his right hand. A sword hangs from his waist, with its hilt visible. The background is dark, with what appears to be drapery on the left side.

artworks.title: Christopher Carleill
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing facing forward with his body angled slightly to the right. He has a stern expression with distinct facial features, including a mustache and a pointed beard. His hair is styled away from his face. The man is dressed in a high-collared garment with ornamental detailing and a sash across his chest. He holds an object in his right hand, which rests against his body. In the background, there are ships with sails visible. An emblem with a crest and the words "Sufficere Anchora" is in the upper right corner. Text at the bottom references Captain Christopher Carleill and a poetic inscription. The image is crafted in an engraved style.

artworks.title: Christopher Carleill
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, high cheekbones, and a calm expression. His hair is short and combed back. He is wearing elaborate period clothing - a collared shirt with a ruffled edge and a detailed, buttoned coat with structured shoulders. The oval frame around the portrait bears the inscription "CHRISTOPHERUS CARLEIUS AMIGER". There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is a flat, shaded surface, with some Latin text below the oval frame. The portrait is set on textured paper with faint text visible on the page.

artworks.title: Christopher Carleill
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man's upper body, facing forward with a slight turn to his left. He has distinct facial features such as a strong jawline, high cheekbones, a neatly trimmed moustache, and a small pointed beard. The man has short, wavy hair styled back from his forehead. He is dressed in a formal outfit with a high-collared shirt and an ornate jacket. The portrait is contained within an oval frame with the name "Christopher" and other text. The background has a patterned, crosshatched design.

artworks.title: Lucy Percy, Second Wife of James Hay, First Earl of Carlisle
artworks.artist: Pieter de Bailliu after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a detailed engraving. She is portrayed from the waist upwards, with her body slightly turned to the left and her head facing forward. The woman has a serene expression with large eyes, a small mouth, and a curved nose. Her hair is styled in curls with floral decorations, falling to her shoulders. She wears a textured gown with ruffled sleeves and lace edges. The woman rests her right arm on a surface and her left hand is near her chest. A pearl necklace adorns her neck. The background shows an architectural element and a view of mountainous terrain under a cloudy sky.
